Natural Gemstone and Agate Wind Chime Collection
Mixed Mineral Specimens
Total Weight: 6 lbs
This substantial collection features a diverse range of natural mineral specimens alongside a decorative rock wind chime. The lot showcases a variety of geological formations, including sparkling crystal-lined geodes and vibrant agate banding. Ideal for lapidary enthusiasts, home decor, or metaphysical collections, this 6-pound assortment includes amethyst, quartz, and polished agate components.
2 Amethyst crystal clusters with distinct purple druzy formations
5 Natural hollow geodes with sparkling white crystal interiors
7 Polished agate slices in a variety of natural and dyed colors
1 Agate slice wind chime with 7 suspended stones on a wooden ring
Includes white polished egg and tumbled accent stones
Condition:
Very good pre-owned condition. The amethyst and quartz geodes show well-preserved crystal points. Agate slices are polished with smooth faces, though some natural rough edges and fissures are present as expected with raw mineral specimens. The wind chime is fully intact and functional. Items show minimal wear consistent with previous display. Total lot weight is 6 pounds.
